task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the image overlay or slider in Weasis; it should indicate '3/5' or show Instance Number 3.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to navigate and export rather than just using CLI tools to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis menus, sliders, or export buttons.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find existing files but actively created/exported them.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamps or the sequence of actions should show the export dialog being filled out and the text editor being used to type the content.

integrity.description: The agent actually changed the slice index in the viewer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The visual content of the CT image in the viewport should change as the agent moves from the default slice to slice 3.
